content_units: Café Sales Performance Snapshot
I reviewed the 3 days of sales and compared each product on   total units  ,   total revenue  , and   average selling price per unit  .
-   Best promotion candidate:   Latte
-   Solid secondary support:   Americano
-   Looks weakest:   Blueberry Muffin
-   Middle performer with room to improve:   Croissant
Product Strength Ranking
Product   Total Units   Total Revenue   Avg Price/Unit   Performance Read
Latte   128   512   4.00   Strongest seller and top revenue driver
Americano   95   285   3.00   Reliable volume, lower revenue than Latte
Croissant   76   266   3.50   Decent support item, moderate performer
Blueberry Muffin   41   164   4.00   Weakest demand despite solid unit price
What deserves more promotion
-   Latte
- Already your strongest item in both units and revenue.
- Worth promoting because demand is proven; added visibility is likely to convert well.
- Good candidate for premium upsells, combo deals, or “featured drink” placement.
-   Americano
- Consistent sales across all 3 days.
- Good product to promote if you want a dependable volume driver at a lower price point.
- Could respond well to morning commuter promos or coffee + pastry bundles.
What looks weak
-   Blueberry Muffin
- Lowest units and lowest revenue by a wide margin.
- Price is not the issue by itself; demand appears weak.
- This is the clearest product to reconsider, reposition, bundle, or rotate out if shelf space is limited.
Watchlist item
-   Croissant
- Not weak enough to cut immediately, but not strong enough to lead.
- It may perform better when paired with coffee promotions rather than pushed alone.
Recommended Charts
Chart 1: Product Performance Comparison
Use a   grouped bar chart   with:
- X-axis: Product
- Y-axis: Values
- Series: Total Units and Total Revenue
Why it helps:
- Quickly shows which products sell most and which generate the most money.
- Makes the gap between Latte and Blueberry Muffin obvious.
Chart 2: Daily Sales Trend by Product
Use a   multi-line chart   with:
- X-axis: Date
- Y-axis: Units sold
- One line per product
Why it helps:
- Shows whether products are steady, rising, or slipping day to day.
- Makes it easy to spot that Blueberry Muffin trends downward across the 3 days.
Five Plain-English Insights
1.   Latte is your star product.   It sold the most units and brought in the most revenue, so it deserves the most promotional support.
2.   Blueberry Muffin is the weakest item.   It sold far fewer units than every other product, so customer interest looks low.
3.   Americano is dependable but not a top earner.   It moves steadily, but because the price is lower, it generates much less revenue than Latte.
4.   Croissant performs okay but is not a standout.   It helps sales, but it is not strong enough to be your main focus unless paired with drinks.
5.   The menu likely has one clear winner and one clear underperformer.   Latte is the item to amplify; Blueberry Muffin is the item to test, bundle, discount, or rethink.
